The Cordillera Executive Board is hereby directed
to release to the Cordillera Regional Assembly the sum of one
million one hundred twenty five thousand pesos (P1,125,000.00) to
cover all the operations of the Cordillera Regional Assembly,
which sum shall be allocated as follows for each and every member
of the Cordillera Regional Assembly: per diem of five hundred
pesos (P500.00) per day for five days; honorarium of one thousand
pesos (P1,000.00) and actual travelling expenses not to exceed
one thousand pesos (F1,000.00).
This Executive Order shall take effect ine-
Done in the City of Manila this 12th day of July, in the
year of Our Lord. nineteen hundred and eighty-eight.
